decision.observation: Diffuser blueprint holds only 29.5 kg of the 200 kg Copper Ore it needs, and the resource panel lists no Metal Ore at all. A single copper ore block drops ~600 kg, so one reachable ore tile would finish the build. The ladder shaft at x≈905 px is the only standing point near the unexplored rock, and ladder dig reach is 2 tiles sideways / 4 up / 3 down. The current tool state is uncertain after toggling Cancel.
decision.hypothesis: Arming the Dig tool cleanly (rather than dragging with an unknown tool armed, which could cancel my existing dig orders) then designating the rock hugging the ladder shaft will open terrain within ladder reach and expose an ore block.
decision.memory: Copper ore block yields ~600 kg — one tile settles the diffuser's 170 kg shortfall. Red Alert adds 50%/cycle stress (now off). 'Made a mess' comes from full bladder (no outhouse), and a 100%-stress dupe may attack equipment. Ore unreachable from dupes is treated as nonexistent.
